The Router underestimated the severity of this semantic conflict. The 'melted' objects are not just texture anomalies but semantic failures that confuse the classifier. The perceptual quality auditor noted slight compression, which is minor compared to the structural issues.

This semantic conflict significantly lowers alignment. The close-up view prevents verification of key prison features (walls, towers), leaving the classification ambiguous. artifact_reasoning: Significant structural artifacts are present. The vertical bars exhibit warping and inconsistent spacing (structural collapse). The objects on the shelves are melted and indistinct (texture/semantic anomaly). The depth map shows high variance, indicating spatial instability. The classifier's confusion between 'prison' and 'library' highlights a semantic artifact where the AI blended two concepts poorly. These are moderate-to-severe artifacts that degrade the image's realism and coherence.
